title: WorkerOfferingRecord
description: Worker registry offering record (§C.4). Describes a specific worker service: which contract/function it targets, what trigger class it uses, what it costs, and which operator provides it. Orbital verifies operator identity and contract existence but does not guarantee the worker's execution correctness or availability.

contractId.description: Target contract address (C…) this worker invokes.

functionName.description: Function name on the target contract this worker invokes.

triggerClass.description: The trigger class this offering responds to.

operatorId.description: The operator providing this offering (references OperatorRecord.id).

version.description: Semantic version of this record. Increments on any change.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update.

OperatorTerms.description: Structured service terms for this offering. Comparable across operators because they are data, not prose.

pricePerInvocation.description: Price per invocation in the specified denomination.

dailyCap.description: Maximum number of invocations per day, or 0 for unlimited.

slaMs.description: SLA response time in milliseconds, or 0 if no SLA is offered.
